description: A sine oscillator whose frequency, phase or amplitude is modulated by the two audio inputs.

params.text: How much the FQ jack moves the pitch. With nothing patched into FQ this knob is a fine tune instead.
How much the first audio input modulates the oscillator.
How much the G1 jack moves that first modulation depth.
How much the second audio input modulates the oscillator.
How much the G2 jack moves that second modulation depth.
Chooses how the two inputs modulate the oscillator: up is frequency modulation, middle is phase modulation, down is amplitude modulation.

inputs.text: Moves the second modulation depth, by as much as the MOD knob beside GAIN 2 allows.
Moves the first modulation depth, by as much as the MOD knob beside GAIN 1 allows.
Sets the pitch of the oscillator at one volt per octave.
Moves the pitch, by as much as the MOD knob beside FQ allows.
The first modulating signal. With nothing patched here the first modulation is silent.
The second modulating signal. With nothing patched here the second modulation is silent.

notes: Set Rack's sample rate to 96kHz before using this module. At any other rate it runs at the wrong speed, and a red bar appears across the bottom of the panel saying so.
An unpatched modulation CV jack does not read 0V: the firmware drives it from an internal chaotic generator, so a MOD knob turned up with nothing patched lets a wandering voltage through.
